executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under heavy pressure. Server DRAM, DRAM and HBM are currently among the most constrained areas. The Daily Check on 2026-08-13 reviewed 8 current relevant reports; there is currently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure, but will reach the market only with a time lag. For buyers, supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
